description: This Java source file implements the CustomerDAOImpl class, which provides data access methods for Customer entities, including retrieval by ID, name, nick, and listing customers by store, using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: CustomerDAOImpl
classes.description: Data Access Object implementation for Customer entity, providing methods to retrieve customer data from the database.

methods.name: CustomerDAOImpl
methods.description: Constructor for CustomerDAOImpl, calls superclass constructor.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity based on its ID, with associated fetch joins for related entities.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching a given name, searching both first and last name fields.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific store, with optional filtering based on criteria such as name, email, and country, and supports pagination.

methods.name: getByNick
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer by their nickname, optionally within a specific store.
